<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 211.0764, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈210.069 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₁₁H₁₄O₄ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 210.089 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). No additional heteroatoms are indicated, so the molecular formula is simply C₁₁H₁₄O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O4</final_answer>
